nl_query: Feを含むB2化合物を出して
sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group FROM material_entry m JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id WHERE (s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2') AND c.element = 'Fe' LIMIT 100;

nl_query: 安定なL1₂型化合物を形成エネルギーが低い順に出して
sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull FROM material_entry m JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12') AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC LIMIT 100;

nl_query: NiとAlを両方含むB2とL1₂化合物を出して
sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a FROM material_entry m JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12' OR s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_ni WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_ni.element = 'Ni') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_al WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_al.element = 'Al') LIMIT 100;

nl_query: B2化合物をバンドギャップが大きい順に出して

nl_query: Co3TiとNi3Alの格子定数を比較して。

nl_query: L1₂化合物のNi3Alとの格子定数差を小さい順に出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS mismatch
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: L1₂型化合物の体積あたり原子数と格子定数の関係を出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: L1₂型化合物のγ'相候補をランキングして、安定性とバルクモジュラスで評価して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_mismatch
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: 安定なL1₂化合物のバルクモジュラスとせん断弾性率を同時に出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       cp_sm.value AS shear_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_sm ON cp_sm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_sm.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: Aサイト元素ごとにL1₂型化合物の平均格子定数と安定割合を集計して。
sql:
SELECT c.element AS a_site_element,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stable_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: NiまたはCoを含む安定なL1₂化合物でバルクモジュラスが高いトップ10を出して。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_ni WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_ni.element = 'Ni')
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_co WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_co.element = 'Co'))
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

nl_query: 安定なL1₂化合物の生成エンタルピーを低い順に出して。
sql:
SELECT fh.formula, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
       fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.is_stable
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND fh.is_stable = true
ORDER BY fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: Ni3Alの生成エンタルピーを純物質基準エネルギーから計算して。
sql:
WITH compound AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE m.formula = 'Ni3Al'
    LIMIT 1
),
ref_energies AS (
    SELECT c.entry_id,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM compound c
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = c.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT c.formula,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom,
       r.weighted_ref AS ref_energy,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom - r.weighted_ref AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM compound c
JOIN ref_energies r ON r.entry_id = c.entry_id;

nl_query: 各元素の多形数を多い順にリストして。

nl_query: 生成エンタルピーが-0.3eV/atom未満の安定なL1₂化合物を格子定数付きで出して。
sql:
SELECT fh.formula, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
       fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy,
       fh.space_group, fh.lattice_a
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND fh.is_stable = true
  AND fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: 遷移金属の基底状態エネルギーを原子番号順に出して。
sql:
SELECT per.element_symbol, e.atomic_number,
       per.energy_per_atom, per.ground_state_spacegroup
FROM pure_element_reference per
JOIN element e ON e.symbol = per.element_symbol
WHERE e.block = 'd'
ORDER BY e.atomic_number ASC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: 形成エネルギーがエネルギーアバブハルより小さいL1₂化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < ps.energy_above_hull
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: 体積弾性率が剪断弾性率の2倍以上大きい化合物を出して。延性指標として。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, et.bulk_modulus_vrh, et.shear_modulus_vrh,
       et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0) AS bulk_shear_ratio
FROM material_entry m
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE et.bulk_modulus_vrh > 2.0 * et.shear_modulus_vrh
  AND et.shear_modulus_vrh > 0
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh / et.shear_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: デバイ温度がキュリー温度より高い化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, tp.debye_temperature_k, mp.curie_temperature_k
FROM material_entry m
JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE tp.debye_temperature_k > mp.curie_temperature_k
  AND mp.curie_temperature_k > 0
ORDER BY tp.debye_temperature_k - mp.curie_temperature_k DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: CBMエネルギーがVBMエネルギーより高く、バンドギャップが2eV未満の化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, bs.cbm_energy, bs.vbm_energy,
       bs.cbm_energy - bs.vbm_energy AS calculated_gap,
       bs.is_direct_gap
FROM material_entry m
JOIN band_structure bs ON bs.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE bs.cbm_energy > bs.vbm_energy
  AND bs.cbm_energy - bs.vbm_energy < 2.0
ORDER BY bs.cbm_energy - bs.vbm_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: A-site元素の原子半径がB-site元素より大きいL1₂化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula,
       ea.symbol AS a_site, ea.atomic_radius AS a_radius,
       eb.symbol AS b_site, eb.atomic_radius AS b_radius,
       ea.atomic_radius - eb.atomic_radius AS radius_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
JOIN element ea ON ea.symbol = ca.element
JOIN element eb ON eb.symbol = cb.element
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ea.atomic_radius > eb.atomic_radius
ORDER BY ea.atomic_radius - eb.atomic_radius DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: 粒界エネルギーが余剰体積より大きい化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, gb.gb_energy_j_m2, gb.excess_volume,
       gb.sigma_value, gb.tilt_angle
FROM material_entry m
JOIN grain_boundary gb ON gb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE gb.gb_energy_j_m2 > gb.excess_volume
  AND gb.excess_volume > 0
ORDER BY gb.gb_energy_j_m2 DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: 全磁化が形成エネルギーの絶対値より大きい化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula, mp.total_magnetization,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ABS(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS abs_formation_energy
FROM material_entry m
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE mp.total_magnetization > ABS(ps.formation_energy_per_atom)
ORDER BY mp.total_magnetization DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: 構成元素間の電気陰性度差が0.5より大きいL1₂化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT m.formula,
       MAX(e.electronegativity) - MIN(e.electronegativity) AS en_diff,
       MAX(e.electronegativity) AS max_en,
       MIN(e.electronegativity) AS min_en
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN element e ON e.symbol = c.element
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
GROUP BY m.formula
HAVING MAX(e.electronegativity) - MIN(e.electronegativity) > 0.5
ORDER BY MAX(e.electronegativity) - MIN(e.electronegativity) DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: 補正前と補正後の生成エンタルピーの差が0.01eV/atomより大きいL1₂化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT fh.formula, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
       fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy,
       fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom - fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy AS correction_magnitude
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom - fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy) > 0.01
ORDER BY ABS(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom - fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy) DESC
LIMIT 10000;

nl_query: B2化合物の生成エンタルピーを純物質基準で計算して、低い順にトップ10を出して。
sql:
WITH b2_enthalpy AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2')
    GROUP BY m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
)
SELECT formula,
       ROUND(formation_energy_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS e_form,
       ROUND(weighted_ref::numeric, 4) AS e_ref,
       ROUND((formation_energy_per_atom - weighted_ref)::numeric, 4) AS delta_h_f
FROM b2_enthalpy
ORDER BY formation_energy_per_atom - weighted_ref ASC
LIMIT 10;

nl_query: Al含有L1₂化合物の生成エンタルピーを計算して、安定な順にトップ10を出して。
sql:
WITH all_l12 AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
),
enthalpy AS (
    SELECT al.entry_id, al.formula, al.formation_energy_per_atom,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM all_l12 al
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = al.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    GROUP BY al.entry_id, al.formula, al.formation_energy_per_atom
),
al_bearing AS (
    SELECT e.entry_id, e.formula,
           e.formation_energy_per_atom - e.weighted_ref AS delta_h_f
    FROM enthalpy e
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM composition c WHERE c.entry_id = e.entry_id AND c.element = 'Al'
    )
)
SELECT formula, ROUND(delta_h_f::numeric, 4) AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM al_bearing
ORDER BY delta_h_f ASC
LIMIT 10;

nl_query: L1₂化合物で純物質基準補正の影響が大きい（補正量の絶対値が0.005 eV/atomより大きい）ものを出して。
sql:
WITH corrected AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    GROUP BY m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
)
SELECT formula,
       ROUND(formation_energy_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS raw_e_form,
       ROUND((formation_energy_per_atom - weighted_ref)::numeric, 4) AS corrected_e_form,
       ROUND(weighted_ref::numeric, 4) AS correction
FROM corrected
WHERE ABS(weighted_ref) > 0.005
ORDER BY ABS(weighted_ref) DESC
LIMIT 10;
